title: 从上下文偏移到风格崩溃：训练目标比规模更重要
summary: 研究发现，现代LLM训练中，指令微调系统会导致语言熵沿语篇和结构维度系统性崩溃（平均放大1949-16853%），复杂标点被抑制到基线频率的3.2-23.2%。弱干预加剧崩溃240%，而强控制（lambda=5.0）可改善40.5%，在200-1000倍规模劣势下超越前沿模型96.7-98.2%。揭示了偏好优化重塑语言分布的结构性限制。
summary_en: Research shows instruction-tuned LLMs cause systematic collapse of language entropy along discourse and structural dimensions (mean amplification 1,949-16,853%), suppressing complex punctuation to 3.2-23.2% of baseline. Weak intervention worsens collapse by 240%, while strong control (lambda=5.0) achieves 40.5% improvement, outperforming frontier models by 96.7-98.2% despite 200-1000x scale disadvantage. Reveals structural limitations of preference optimization.
